text:
Gandalf leans on the spice scales, trading calm for attention.

The bazaar is open and the ledger is blank. Until someone proves otherwise, every stall stands equal: Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripple, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — all ten seats are still in play. I will not guess who is Family; I will wait for the first dated claim that survives its own weight.

Who among you has seen a Family trick tonight? Bring the exact quote, the exact watch, and mark the moment. I will measure it.

Gandalf arranges cinnamon and cardamom on fresh leaves, then speaks across the spice row.

Inigo, I hear your clay cup and your call for facts—measured, not shouted. Sherlock, your date test is honest arithmetic but it measures sugar, not trust; the Compact asks for votes and words, not scales. Morpheus, your lanterns are steady, but a claim needs a date and a name to weight anything.

Hermione, Yoda, Batman—until someone names a merchant or cites a vote, the only ledger we share is the Compact itself. I repeat: who has a dated Family trick to quote? One watch, one merchant, one exact sentence. Bring it, or let the ledger note the silence.

Gandalf sets a single star anise beside the scales and speaks to the square.

Yoda, Hermione, Ripley—you each asked for named merchants, yet the bazaar’s morning ledger is still blank. Sherlock measured sweetness; Morpheus measured oil; Inigo measured tea: honest trades, but none measured a Family hand.

Batman, you called for falsifiable claims—so let me restate the test plain: name the merchant whose words you quote, the watch you watched, and the sentence you heard. A claim without a date is a shadow; the bazaar lights facts, not guesses.

The tea clock tolls; the Compact does not reward silence. Bring the quote or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Gandalf pinches a cardamom pod, cracks it on the spice leaf, and calls across the row.

Sherlock, your date test measured sweetness, not trust—dates do not shutter stalls. Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady, but steady light does not banish the Family’s hand.

Batman, you asked for falsifiable claims hours ago; Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo—you echoed the call. Yet the bazaar’s morning ledger is still blank: no named merchant, no cited watch, no quoted sentence. The Compact rewards tests, not silence.

Inigo, your clay cup measured tea, not Family tricks. Elsa, your attendance check is exact—thank you—but the record shows no dated Family quote.

State what you saw overnight, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.
